items.title: Meta's Ember is a bet on cheaper models with competitors

items.title: “Demand Is Higher Than Supply”: AMD Has Ripped 141% in 2026. Is It Too Late to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD stock is up 141% in 2026 on Meta’s 6-gigawatt GPU deal and back-to-back record quarters, though it’s still 21% below its October closing high. AMD guided to about $17 billion of fourth-quarter revenue, more than Intel expects, and CEO Lisa Su says demand for AMD’s chips is higher than supply as AI buyers line up a second supplier to Nvidia.

items.title: Meta Platforms (META) Wins JPMorgan Backing, Is It Still 37% Below Fair Value?
items.summary: JPMorgan’s endorsement of Meta Platforms (META) as its preferred internet stock, driven by AI-powered advertising performance and expected Family of Apps ad revenue relative to Google Search, has sharpened investor focus on Meta’s equity story. The recent optimism around Meta Platforms comes after a mixed stretch for the share price. The stock is up 10.8% over 90 days but down 10.8% over the past month and slightly lower year to date. items.title: Snap Sinks 11% in a Week on 4% Ad Growth: “Below Our Ambitions”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSnap stock fell 11% in a week after its third-quarter report, as advertising revenue grew just 4% and daily users missed estimates. Pinterest’s outlook was soft too, but Meta Platforms grew its ad revenue 26%, so Snap’s slowdown looks like its own problem.
